design_rationale:
WORKLOG - task 1 of guest_protection_desk (Keyturn Guest Protection Plan)

STEP 0 - DRAW, ASSET LEDGER AND CLAIM
draw_counts.py env/env_0015_car_sharing_marketplace/tasks/guest_protection_desk --task 1 printed
{"task": 1, "key": "env_0015_car_sharing_marketplace/guest_protection_desk/1", "prerequisite_problems": 1,
"problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 4]}.
So the tree has exactly one prerequisite problem besides the root, and the two computations carry 5 and 4
declared factors as a multiset. Assigned: the protection fee assessment takes 5, the level election cover 4.
Already occupied by task 0: guestplan_ext_additional_driver_charge, guestplan_ext_young_driver_surcharge and
guestplan_ext_level_change_difference, with declare_additional_driver_a214c8dd,
post_young_driver_surcharge_f46febb9 and price_level_change_f4995b0a. This task claims the two that were
deliberately left free - guestplan_ext_level_election_cover and guestplan_ext_protection_fee_assessment, with
confirm_protection_level_63b6fff8 and post_protection_fee_513639f7. The two scopes are disjoint in both
policies and tools, and together the two tasks cover all five extended policies of the difficulty, so nothing is
reserved and nothing is idle. Of the two writes in this product that are the guest's own, task 0 took the
declaring of an additional driver and this task takes the choosing of a protection level, so both trees carry an
owner=user problem without sharing one.
Where task 0 worked a live election a month into its trip - a level change against a fee already charged - this
task works the other end of the life of an election: a quote standing on a confirmed trip that has not yet
started, where the level itself and the number of days of cover are still open and the first fee has never been
raised. No policy core, target write or source of difficulty is reused.

DESIGN THESIS
Surface goal: a guest collects a long-stay vehicle tomorrow morning, has been charged for the trip and sees
nothing at all against the protection, and rings to have the cover priced and charged before she picks the car
up. Scored core parameter: fee_amount on that election. Between the goal and that number the policy puts one
hop the customer never mentions. The fee policy's own rule says the protection fee for a trip is fixed only once
the election has left the quoted state and carries the number of days of cover the level will run for; the
records show an election still in the quoted state carrying the reserved days of the trip as quoted, so the
election must be settled first - and settling it is the guest's own act, which the desk unlocks and hands over.
Settling it is not a formality: the level is not a free choice either, and which level is open to her follows
from her marketplace driving score, the marketplace's valuation and value class of the vehicle, and the number
of days of cover the election will carry, so the agent has to work the covered days out before it can say which
level can be taken at all.
Breadth: the covered days rest on four ladders reading the rate plan, the reserved period, the delivery point
and the guest's twelve-month trip ledger in another difficulty; the fee rests on five more reading the level's
own basis, that same ledger, the reserved period in days and in whole months, and the miles the trip includes.
The customer names no level, no day count and no figure.

CHECK CARD 1 - BASE INVARIANTS
Write subject guestplan_election_confirmed: two base policies have a subject that intersects it.
guestplan_agg_claim_history has no structured eligibility, so its scope of application governs the write - the
elections of one guest are read together, losses settled over the rolling twelve months can close a level, and a
guest whose covered days would take one trip past a level's maximum trip length is quoted on the level that will
carry the whole trip. At frozen_time the guest has no settled loss on any election, so no level is closed to her
on that ground, while the covered days of 81 do close Keyturn Minimum Protection and Keyturn Standard Protection,
whose maximum trip length is 60 days.
guestplan_election_eligibility carries two gates that apply to this subject.
  own_policy_evidenced, verbatim: 'Declining marketplace protection is open only to a guest who evidences their
  own motor policy carrying at least the level's minimum third-party limit, and the guest's word that they are
  insured is not evidence of it.' Authority system_record, timing pre_action, correlation key
  guestplan_elections.election_id bound to the action argument election_id. The election carries no external
  insurer and the guest says she runs no car of her own and has nothing in her own name, so declining is not open
  to her and the level taken is not the declined one; the gate holds.
  trip_confirmed_not_started, verbatim: 'A guest may choose a level only for a trip that has been confirmed and
  has not yet started, since a level chosen after the vehicle has been collected would cover a risk already
  taken.' Its state contract admits the booked state alone. Correlation key trips_bookings.booking_id bound to
  the action argument booking_id. At frozen_time, 2026-06-01 10:45:00 CDT, the booking stands booked with a
  reserved start of 2026-06-02 and no actual start date, so the gate holds; had the call come a day later with
  the vehicle collected, the correct handling would be to settle nothing and the quote would lapse.
Neither policy carries a time eligibility, so temporal_feasibility is empty for this task and no anchor question
arises on this subject.
Write subject guestplan_protection_fee_charged: the only base policy governing it is guestplan_evt_fee_charging,
whose single gate is election_chosen_before_charging, verbatim: 'A fee line is posted only while the election is
in the elected or active state, since a quote that was never chosen is never charged.' Authority system_record,
correlation key guestplan_elections.election_id bound to election_id. At the opening the election is quoted and
the gate is FALSE; it becomes true only through the guest's own settlement at the preceding step, which is why
the contract cites that step's DB delta as its pre-action evidence rather than the seeded row.
Inherited and untouched: base's billing points, its minimum charge days, its rule that the fee is posted once
against the election that carries the cover, and its rule that additional drivers are charged the level's
additional driver fee all stay in force; only the two clauses named in overwrite are superseded.

CHECK CARD 2 - BUSINESS OBJECT
Narrowest object: election beec17ca-50e3-4ab4-bc1a-41afda1cfb91, the single election attached to booking
eedb1e65-e9c3-4770-9d6c-f63ee8cc6ee3, the only confirmed and not-yet-started trip the guest holds. Correlation
key: election_id on the settlement and on the fee line, with booking_id tying both to the trip. Rows entering
the aggregates: only the guest's own trip charge lines, narrowed by charge_basis to late returns, base rates and
mileage overages, and then by the twelve-month window, which excludes the two lines on the April 2025 booking.
Rows excluded: the delivery fee and the marketplace trip fee on the live booking, which no ladder reads, and
every line on the three earlier bookings that falls outside its window. No protection line stands anywhere on
this election, so nothing has been settled, reversed or compensated and no existing credit has to be netted; the
fee line this task writes is the first on the election and carries the initial coverage segment.

CHECK CARD 3 - PROBLEM TREE
Root: guestplan_ext_protection_fee_assessment (the money the customer asks about).
Edge: guestplan_ext_protection_fee_assessment depends on guestplan_ext_level_election_cover.
  kind value_input; gate charged_days; form state.
  Prerequisite sentence, verbatim from the blocked policy's own rule: 'The protection fee for a trip is fixed
  only once the election has left the quoted state and carries the number of days of cover the level will run
  for.'
  Four-point test: (1) the ordering connective is 'only once', joining this policy's own result, the protection
  fee for a trip, to what it waits on; the affirmative direction is the one the desk uses of a charge it will
  not yet fix. Rewritten in the negated direction it reads 'the protection fee for a trip is not fixed until the
  election has left the quoted state and carries the number of days of cover the level will run for' - the exact
  contrapositive, same result, same waited-on state, same scope, nothing added, dropped or split, and the
  negation covers the whole of the waited-on condition rather than listing failure cases. (2) The XX side is a
  record-visible state: the election's own state, which the tables show as quoted or otherwise, and the number
  of days of cover written on it. (3) It names no tool, no policy id and no code token. (4) It is a hard
  requirement of exactly the edge's scope, the state of the election and its days of cover, no wider and no
  narrower.
  Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: only guestplan_ext_level_election_cover settles
  an election out of the quoted state and writes the days of cover onto it, so a reader who checks the election,
  sees it standing as a quote with no days of cover settled, and reads the other policies' rules reaches that
  problem and no other.
  Handling-time state (condition): the election stands in the elected state with the level it will run on and
  the number of days of cover written on it. Resolving action: confirm_protection_level_63b6fff8, owner user -
  choosing the cover that will run on her own trip is the guest's own decision and the marketplace does not make
  it for her.
  False at the opening: initial_state.guestplan_elections.beec17ca-50e3-4ab4-bc1a-41afda1cfb91.status is quoted;
  its coverage_days is 75, the reserved days of the trip as quoted rather than the days a settled level will run
  for; its protection_fee_balance_due is 0.00, nothing having been charged against a quote.
  Derivation: the reader of the fee rule learns the fee waits on the election having left the quoted state and
  carrying its days of cover; the election lookup shows it standing as a quote; the only rule in the charter
  that moves an election out of the quoted state and writes its days of cover is the level election cover
  policy, whose own rule says what it settles; so the one action is to have that election settled, and because
  that policy's action is the guest's own, the desk unlocks it and hands it over. The hop admits exactly one
  reading.
Topological order: guestplan_ext_level_election_cover, then guestplan_ext_protection_fee_assessment. The tree is
a single edge, so there are no parallel edges to reorder and no commutation argument is needed.
Per-edge deletion sensitivity, from the Step 5 run: skipping the settlement leaves the charged days at 75 and
the level at the quoted Keyturn Standard Protection, and the scored fee_amount at 2338.95 instead of 3238.53.
user_scenario mentions no prerequisite problem and the tool layer validates none; both are argued in full in
prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint and prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block.

STEP 1 - POLICIES
guestplan_ext_level_election_cover (state_due; subject guestplan_election_confirmed; computes
covered_days_count; target confirm_protection_level_63b6fff8, owner user). base_policy_refs
[guestplan_agg_claim_history, guestplan_election_eligibility, guestplan_evt_fee_charging] - the first two govern
the subject, the third is the genuine input lineage of the day count this policy refines. overwrite names one
clause of guestplan_evt_fee_charging, 'Charged days are the whole days of the trip as reserved, with any part
day counted as a whole day, and never fewer than the level's minimum charge days.', replaced by this policy's
closing sentence. Trigger: with nobody calling, a quote standing on a confirmed trip that starts tomorrow is
something the records owe a settlement on before the trip begins - leave it and the quote lapses and the trip
runs uncovered - so it is state_due rather than a quote the guest has to ask for.
guestplan_ext_protection_fee_assessment (state_due; subject guestplan_protection_fee_charged; computes
fee_amount; target post_protection_fee_513639f7, owner agent). base_policy_refs [guestplan_evt_fee_charging].
overwrite names the floor-and-ceiling clause, 'The fee arrived at is then held between the level's floor and its
ceiling, the floor applied first and the ceiling last, so a trip long enough to pass the ceiling pays the
ceiling and no more.', replaced by this policy's closing sentence. Neither overwrite quotes the sentence a gate
condition carries, so election_chosen_before_charging, own_policy_evidenced and trip_confirmed_not_started all
stay in force and are inherited into the contract. Trigger: once an election is settled the fee for the trip is
owed at the level's billing point whether or not the guest rings, so state_due.
Each (target_tool, computes) pair is claimed once across the difficulty. Both policies declare cross_category
[trips], matched exactly by their compute and by inputs.cross_category, and both write only guestplan tables.

Forward references rule -> compute_basis -> compute: every binding that reads the world, aggregates, chooses,
caps or rounds carries a verbatim rule sentence - the level lookups quote the baseline fee sentence or the
sentence naming the basis they select, each ladder binding quotes its own tier sentences, and each result
binding quotes the closing 'therefore' sentence that fixes the order of operations and the single rounding.
Reverse sweep compute -> rule: every load-bearing sentence is claimed. 'over the last twelve months' corresponds
to within_months=12 on XCOUNT with date_field='charge_date'; 'the whole weeks of the reserved period, each
counted as the long plan week days and any part week counted as a whole week' corresponds to the rounding-up
expression over reserved_span_days; 'the calendar days from the first reserved day to the last reserved day,
both days included' corresponds to DAYS(trip_first_day, trip_last_day) + 1; 'held to the cover ceiling that
applies' and 'under the trip ceiling that applies' correspond to MN; 'held at the level's floor' corresponds to
MX; 'rounded to two decimal places only once the whole of it has been worked out' corresponds to the single RND
wrapping the whole result. No filter appears in an expression that the quoted sentence does not carry, and no
sentence promises a quantity no binding computes.
Semantic choices pinned in prose rather than behind a summary word: the covered-days rule states that the
handover grace and the late-return allowance are added to the plan days and that the ceiling is applied to that
total, so the order of the three is fixed; the fee rule states that the loyalty rate is taken on the fee the
level's basis produces, that the long-stay discount then reduces that figure, that the floor is applied before
the ceiling, that the mileage step is added to the capped figure and so sits outside both the discount and the
ceiling, and that the rounding happens once, at the end and nowhere else; and the trip price is defined
explicitly as the daily rate locked in on the trip taken for each of the reserved days rather than left as
'the trip price'.

STEP 2 - TOOLS
confirm_protection_level_63b6fff8 (owner user, rw write). User: the guest. Object: her own protection election.
Atomic action: a protection level taken onto the trip. Change: the election leaves the quoted state onto the
level named, today's date is recorded as the day the level was taken, and the days of cover are written onto it.
Observable: the election standing as chosen on that level for those days, and the receipt naming all three. Its
parameters are only what the guest holds before acting - the references the desk reads out to her, the level the
desk has established is open to her and the day count it has worked out. The enum lists all six levels with the
situation each one answers; the day count is a whole number with no fraction.
post_protection_fee_513639f7 (owner agent, rw write). Object: the same election. Atomic action: the protection
fee for the trip charged once. Change: a new protection line on the daily protection fee basis for the initial
stretch, carrying the fee and the days it was priced on, raising the protection fee the guest owes. Receipt: the
new line reference, the fee and the days.
Neither aggregates history, judges eligibility or checks a prerequisite; each is a bare ctx.update or
ctx.create over the arguments as given.
check_task_tools.py passed on both at every revision.

STEP 3 - SEED
17 rows, all uuid4, no dangling foreign key, closure equal to initial_state (replay reports clos=17 init=17
match=True).
customers: the guest Rosalind Ueda, twenty-nine, with a marketplace driving score of 73 - the single number that
closes Keyturn Premier Protection, which needs 74, Keyturn Business Traveler Protection, which needs 76, and
Keyturn Declined Protection, which needs 80; and the host Theo Sandoval, who owns the listing. Move the score to
74 and the level the guest may take stops being unique, which is exactly why it is seeded at 73.
listings_vehicles: one Land Rover Defender valued by the marketplace at 92,000.00 and listed in the Keyturn
Luxury Class Listing class. The valuation is above the 60,000.00 exclusion ceiling of Keyturn Declined
Protection and the 85,000.00 ceiling of Keyturn Minimum Protection, and the class is one Keyturn Declined
Protection excludes outright, so the row is what rules those levels out. Remove it and that reasoning cannot be
done at all.
trips_bookings: the live booking on the extended stay plan, 2026-06-02 to 2026-08-15, 1800 reserved hours, 7,500
included miles, a daily rate of 145.00 locked at confirmation, delivered to a hotel, standing booked with no
actual start date; and three earlier settled bookings that carry the twelve-month history. The rate plan drives
one ladder, the hours reserved a second, the delivery point a third, the reserved period two more and the
included miles a sixth, so the live booking is load-bearing six times over.
trips_charges: nine lines. On the live trip, 7,830.00 of base rate, 548.10 of marketplace trip fee and 75.00 of
delivery fee, all posted 2026-05-20 - the base rate is 145.00 x 75 x 0.72 under the extended stay plan's 28 per
cent monthly discount, the trip fee its 7 per cent and the delivery fee the plan's own figure, so the lines
teach no arithmetic the charter does not contain. On the January trip, 3,088.80 of base rate on 2026-01-02 and
84.00 of late return on 2026-02-03. On the September trip, 1,557.60 of base rate on 2025-09-08 and 76.00 of late
return on 2025-09-26. On the April 2025 trip, 402.00 of base rate on 2025-04-05 and 33.60 of mileage overage on
2025-04-13.
The near-misses are deliberate. Base rates inside twelve months number three, which reaches the returning trip
count of 2 but not the established count of 4; counting the April 2025 line as well would make four and drop the
loyalty rate a tier. The only mileage overage stands on 2025-04-13, just outside the window; counting it would
send the loyalty rate to the fall-through. The two late returns inside the window are what put the guest on the
top tier of the late-return allowance, and the reserved period of 75 days is five days past the long stay days
of 60 and thirteen days past two whole months, so both the discount tier and the ceiling tier sit close to their
boundaries.
guestplan_elections: one election, quoted on the standard level since 2026-05-20, carrying 75 covered days, no
fee and no deductible, no additional driver and no external insurer. The quoted state with quoted covered days
is the prerequisite made false; the empty external insurer is what shows the guest cannot decline.
guestplan_charges: none. That is the point of the task: the first protection line on this election is the one
the gold writes, and the read that looks for protection lines is what establishes it.
No outcome stamp decides any tier: every ladder reads the rate plan, the reserved period, the delivery point,
the included miles or the trip ledger. No cache field was set against its ledger, so check_cache_diff has
nothing to report here.
Automatic clauses reviewed: guestplan_lifecycle would expire the quote at the moment the trip begins - the trip
begins the day after frozen_time, so nothing has fired yet and settling the election is exactly what stops it;
guestplan_void would void an election whose trip fell away - the booking stands confirmed; guestplan_evt_refund
needs an earlier line to give back against and there is none. On the trips side the three earlier bookings are
settled with nil balances that match their lines, and the live booking's balance of 8,453.10 is the sum of its
three charge lines, so no trips obligation is lit that this difficulty cannot carry.
Handling-time eligibility audit: at the settlement the booking stands booked and not started and the election
carries no external insurer, so both eligibility gates hold; at the fee write the election stands elected, so
the fee gate holds. On the opening world that last gate is false, which is precisely the design.

STEP 4 - PERSONA
Written in Rosalind's voice, and deliberately unlike task 0's: unhurried, methodical, a caller who has already
read her own charges line by line and makes her point once. No headings, no numbered blocks, no conditional
template. Volunteered at the opening: who she is, that the car is delivered to her hotel tomorrow and she keeps
it until the fifteenth of August, that the trip, the delivery and the marketplace fee have all been charged and
there is nothing against the protection, and the request in her own words - I collect the car tomorrow and I
want to know what the cover on this trip is going to cost me and have it charged before I pick it up - together
with the timing and the authorisation boundary. Every one of those facts is entailed by the seed: the booking
dates, the delivery to a hotel, the booked state and the three trip charge lines.
Given only when asked: her mobile 7372208456, her date of birth 1996-11-03, her licence number 53627105, her
postal code 78702 and her email, one at a time. Two answers a real agent must have and gold never uses are
written out: she carries no motor policy of her own and runs no car, which is what a careful agent checks before
ruling on the declined level, and nobody else will be driving, which is what closes the additional driver
question. Explicit cannot-answer branches: any internal reference, and any figure for what the cover should
cost.
Passive reactions, each triggered by something the agent says: she agrees to take the level and does it herself
only after the agent tells her the protection is still only a quote, that the marketplace cannot take the choice
for her, and which level is open to her for how many days; and she closes only after the agent tells her the fee
has been charged and says what it came to. Her last reaction answers the last gold action and asks for nothing
beyond it.
Authority: everything she states about the records is her own reading of her charges, which the seed bears out,
and she never asserts a status the system record contradicts. She knows neither 81 nor 3238.53 and will not be
drawn into naming a figure.

STEP 5 - VERIFICATION AND GT
The handling-time recomputation was run from the policies on disk and this seed, replaying the settlement with
the real tool before the fee was evaluated. Commands and output:
  .venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py env/env_0015_car_sharing_marketplace/tasks/guest_protection_desk --task 1
  -> 1.json comps=2 fact=9 xfac=2 hist=0 brch=54 step=11 match=True ; COMPUTE OK
The two scored values, each on the world as it stands at its own step:
  covered_days_count 81 = MN(77 + 1 + 3, 120).
  fee_amount 3238.53 = MN(MX(3806.25 x 0.94 x 0.88, 38.00), 3200.00) + 90.00, rounded half up to the cent once at the end.
Factor sensitivity, every factor moving the result:
  level election cover: 79 / 80 / 78 / 30 against 81; all four baselines at once give 30.
  protection fee: 2636.12 / 3290.00 / 3290.00 / 1290.00 / 3148.53 against 3238.53; all five at once give 1200.00.
Both whole-baseline figures differ from gold, so an agent who finds only the computation document and none of
the factor documents computes a definite wrong number with no signal.
Prerequisite sensitivity, run separately: skipping the settlement gives 2338.95 in place of 3238.53, because the
charged days fall back to the 75 the quote carries and the level falls back to the quoted standard level. The
edge bears weight.
Whole-input floors: forcing every cross-category read off changes both results; neither computation aggregates
this category's own event history, so the history floor does not apply to this task and the heavy ledger
reconciliation sits in task 0, which reconciles ten rows.
Only then were computations.expected and the gold arguments filled in. The one enum argument, the protection
level, is traced with the three charter sentences that exclude every other candidate - the score minima, the
vehicle exclusions and the maximum trip length - so no second level is reachable.
Draft recomputation from the visible context alone: masking the extended yaml, compute, expected, gold and this
worklog, and working only from the prose the knowledge base will carry, the tool schemas, the rows the finders
return and the caller's actual lines, the same conclusion follows - the fee cannot be fixed while the election
stands as a quote; the covered days come to 81 from the plan's week count, the delivery grace and the late-return
allowance under the extended-stay ceiling; the only level that meets a score of 73, covers a vehicle valued at
92,000.00 in the luxury class and carries 81 days is Keyturn Advantage Protection; the guest must take it
herself; and the fee then comes to 3238.53. No second reading of the hop or of the level was found.

STEP 6 - EVALUATION AND SCOPE
Seven read nodes precede the writes: the member lookup and the identity check; the election; the bookings; the
listing; the protection lines; the guest's trip charge lines. The election read is what shows the cover is still
a quote, which is how the prerequisite is discovered; the member lookup carries the driving score and the
listing carries the valuation and the class, which together make the level unique; the booking read carries the
rate plan, the delivery point, the reserved period and the included miles, which carry six of the nine ladders;
the trip charge read carries the twelve-month ledger behind the other two. The protection-line read returns
nothing, and that emptiness is the fact it establishes. No read is duplicated.
Write nodes follow the topological order: unlock and hand over the guest's own settlement, then charge the fee.
Each write is one problem's target tool, called once.
Closure: charter_scope.extended_policies equals the set of computations.policy_id equals the problems of the
tree; required_documents repeats it verbatim in the same order; charter_scope.task_tools equals the gold tools
in first-use order. Nothing calls the transfer to a human representative, and no policy or tool hangs outside
the tree.
Everything runs under one frozen_time, 2026-06-01 10:45:00 CDT. Nothing waits on the vehicle being collected, on
a payment clearing or on a future date: the settlement and the fee both land now, which is precisely why the
call had to come before the trip begins.

STEP 7 - REVISIONS AND GATES
No red light was raised on this task: the policies, tools, seed and gold were written against the draw and the
check cards and passed every per-task gate on the first run. One design decision is recorded instead of a
revision. The covered days were deliberately kept free of any level parameter, so that the day count can be
worked out before the level is settled; had the level's maximum trip length entered the covered-days formula,
the computation would have had to read the level the election was about to be settled at, which is not in the
records at that moment. The level's maximum trip length is instead used the way the charter uses it, as the test
of which level can carry the cover, and the level's minimum charge day enters the fee policy's charged days.
Per-task gates, all green at the close of this task:
  check_extended.py --task 1      -> EXTENDED OK
  check_task_tools.py --task 1    -> TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK
  replay_tasks.py --task 1        -> REPLAY OK (11 acts, deterministic, non-vacuous, 0 errors, closure matched)
  check_solvability.py --task 1   -> SOLVABILITY OK (2 calls, 4 base gates, 1 seed row)
  check_compute.py --task 1       -> COMPUTE OK
  check_grounding.py --task 1     -> GROUNDING OK
  check_cross_fire.py --task 1    -> SCOPE OK

FACTOR CARD
guestplan_ext_level_election_cover, four factors.
  plan_day_count_convention (method): three tiers deciding how the stretch the cover is metered over is counted -
  whole weeks rounded up, the calendar days of the reserved period, or the reserved hours divided by the hours in
  a day. Tier taken: whole weeks, on the extended stay plan, giving 77. Baseline, the reserved hours convention,
  gives 75 and a result of 79.
  handover_grace_by_delivery (parameter): three tiers on where the vehicle changes hands. Tier taken: delivered
  anywhere other than an airport, 1 day, on a delivery to a hotel. Baseline nil gives 80.
  late_return_allowance (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty trips): three tiers on late returns inside
  twelve months combined with the rate plan. Tier taken: the top tier, 3 days, on the 84.00 of 2026-02-03 and the
  76.00 of 2025-09-26 with an extended stay plan. Baseline nil gives 78.
  cover_ceiling_by_reserved_time (parameter): three tiers on the hours the booking reserves. Tier taken: the long
  ceiling of 120 days, on 1800 reserved hours, which the total does not reach. Baseline, the standard ceiling of
  30, bites and gives 30. It is deliberately keyed on the hours reserved rather than on the rate plan, so that no
  two factors of this task partition on the same condition.
  Whole baseline: 30, the reserved hours over the hours in a day held under the standard cover ceiling - exactly
  what the computation document states.
guestplan_ext_protection_fee_assessment, five factors.
  fee_basis_by_level (method): three tiers on the basis the level arrives at its fee on. Tier taken: the
  greater-of basis, 3,806.25. Baseline, the daily amount for the charged days, 3,078.00, gives 2,636.12.
  loyalty_rate_by_trip_record (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty trips): three tiers on base rates and
  mileage overages inside twelve months. Tier taken: the returning rate, 0.94, on three base rates and no overage
  in the window. Baseline 1.00 gives 3,290.00. Near-miss: the April 2025 base rate and mileage overage, just
  outside the window.
  long_stay_discount (parameter): three tiers on the reserved days. Tier taken: the long rate, 12.0 per cent, on
  75 reserved days. Baseline nil gives 3,290.00.
  trip_fee_ceiling_by_reservation (parameter): three tiers on the whole months reserved. Tier taken: the long
  ceiling, 3,200.00, on two whole months, which the figure does not reach. Baseline, the short ceiling of
  1,200.00, bites and gives 1,290.00.
  mileage_exposure_step (parameter): three tiers on the miles the trip includes. Tier taken: the high step,
  90.00, on 7,500 included miles. Baseline nil gives 3,148.53.

WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST
It forces a different desk capability from task 0's: not reconciling a loaded ledger but establishing, from the
member profile, the listing and the charter's own exclusions, which cover can be written at all; working out how
many days that cover runs for before the level can even be named; and then recognising that the choice itself is
not the marketplace's to make and handing it back to the guest at the right moment. The difficulty is in reading
policy and getting two numbers exactly right, not in choosing between tools, and the customer supplies only her
goal, her identity and her consent.
Easiest mistakes and how the policy excludes them: charging the fee straight away against the quote, which the
fee rule's own sentence forbids and which would give 2338.95; taking the covered days as the 75 the quote

twelve-month window, which would move the loyalty rate; applying the mileage step before the ceiling rather
than after it, which the closing sentence of the rule fixes; and rounding at each step rather than once at the

user_scenario:
Rosalind Ueda is twenty-nine, a theatre lighting designer who has taken a residency in Houston for the summer and has booked a host's Land Rover Defender for the whole of it. The car is delivered to her hotel tomorrow morning and she keeps it until the fifteenth of August. She rings late on the evening before, unhurried but methodical, the sort of caller who has the app open in front of her and has been through the charges line by line. Her point is a plain one and she makes it once: the trip itself has been charged to her card, there is a delivery charge and a marketplace fee, and there is nothing at all against the protection. What she says she wants is this - I collect the car tomorrow and I want to know what the cover on this trip is going to cost me and have it charged before I pick it up. She is happy for the desk to do whatever it can from where it sits, and if some part of it can only come from her she will do it there and then rather than be called back.

She gives her mobile, 7372208456, when she is asked how the account can be found, and her date of birth, 1996-11-03, if a second detail is wanted. Her licence number, 53627105, her postal code, 78702, and her email, rosalind.ueda@northloopmail.com, are all things she will read out, but one at a time and only on being asked. She can say the car is coming to her hotel rather than being collected, that the residency runs to the middle of August, and that she has rented from the same host three or four times before. Anything that looks like an internal reference she does not have: she says the app only shows her the trip, not the numbers behind it, and asks the agent to pull it up their end.

She has an opinion about money but not about protection. If she is asked what she expects the cover to come to she says she has no idea and would rather not guess, since the last time she looked at the wording it may as well have been in Latin, and she will not be talked into naming a number. If she is asked whether she has her own motor insurance she says she does not run a car of her own and has nothing in her own name. If she is asked whether anyone else will be driving she says no, it is just her.

If the agent comes back and tells her that the protection on this trip is still only a quote, that the marketplace cannot take the choice on her behalf, and which level is the one open to her and how many days of cover it would run for, she listens, says that makes sense and that she would rather be covered than not, and when the step is handed over to her she takes it herself there and then. She can read back whatever the confirmation says afterwards if she is asked to.

Once the agent tells her the protection fee has been charged and says what it came to, she says good, that she will watch for it on the card, thanks them for staying late, and rings off. She asks for nothing further.

gold_actions.business_effect: The protection election standing as a quote on the confirmed trip is settled: it leaves the quoted state onto Keyturn Advantage Protection and carries 81 days of cover.

request_binding.action_semantics: A quote stands on a trip that is confirmed and starts the next day; unless the election is settled before the trip begins the quote lapses and the trip runs with no marketplace protection at all, so the records themselves owe a settled election whether or not the guest raises it. The action that discharges it is the taking of a level onto this election, not a fee line, not a move of level and not a void.

discriminator.business_meaning: an election standing as a quote on a confirmed trip that has not yet started

stage_provenance.fact: The guest takes a protection level onto her own trip, which this call completes on the spot.

base_preconditions.condition: Elections are read together when the marketplace decides what it will cover a guest for: losses settled against the guest over the rolling twelve months can close a level to them, and a guest whose covered days would take one trip past a level's maximum trip length is quoted on the level that will carry the whole trip.

Declining marketplace protection is open only to a guest who evidences their own motor policy carrying at least the level's minimum third-party limit, and the guest's word that they are insured is not evidence of it.
A guest may choose a level only for a trip that has been confirmed and has not yet started, since a level chosen after the vehicle has been collected would cover a risk already taken.

gold_actions.business_effect: The protection fee of 3,238.53 the settled level produces for this trip is charged as a protection line on the election for the initial stretch.

request_binding.action_semantics: Once the election stands settled on a level with its days of cover, the protection fee for the trip is owed on the records themselves and falls due at the level's billing point; the action that discharges it is a fee line on the daily protection fee basis, not an additional driver fee, not a difference for a move of level and not a loading.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull up the member profile behind the call from the mobile number the caller states, returning her member reference, date of birth, licence details and marketplace driving score.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Nothing on a protection election can be read or written before the account is identified, and the driving score this returns is what decides which protection levels are open to her at all.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record a passed in-session identity check from the two profile details the caller states, her mobile number and her date of birth.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No money may be charged to the election and no cover settled before the caller is confirmed to be the member who holds it; two matching details are what the check requires.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the protection election attached to the guest's trip: the level quoted, the state it stands in, the days of cover recorded on it, the fee outstanding and whether she has named her own insurer.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The state of the election is what shows the cover is still only a quote; the election reference keys the settlement and the fee, and the level it ends up standing on is what the fee is worked out from.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the guest's trip bookings, above all the confirmed one the election belongs to: its rate plan, its state, the reserved dates and hours, the daily rate locked in at confirmation, the included miles and where the vehicle is delivered.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The rate plan decides how the plan days are counted and which cover ceiling applies, the delivery point decides the handover grace, the reserved period decides the long-stay discount and the trip fee ceiling, the locked daily rate gives the trip price and the included miles decide the mileage step; the booking's state is also the gate on settling cover at all.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the listing the trip is on: its value class and the marketplace's current valuation of the vehicle.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: A level will not cover a vehicle valued above its exclusion ceiling or sitting in one of its excluded value classes, so the valuation and the class are what rule out the lower levels before any level can be settled.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Look for protection lines already standing on this election.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: It has to be established that no protection fee has yet been charged on this election before one is raised, since the fee is charged once against the election that carries the cover.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the guest's own trip charge lines across her marketplace history: base rates, late returns and mileage overages, each with the date it was posted.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The late returns charged inside the last twelve months decide the late-return allowance in the days of cover, and the base rates and mileage overages inside that window decide the loyalty rate the protection fee is taken at.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the customer's own action for taking a protection level onto her trip and hand it to her.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Choosing the cover that will run on her own trip is the guest's decision and the marketplace does not make it for her, so the desk can only set the action up; the unlock has no effect on the records and happens once.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The guest takes the protection level onto her trip herself, which moves the election out of the quoted state onto the level she takes and writes the days of cover it will carry.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The level election cover policy alone fixes covered_days_count; until the election is settled the cover on the trip is a quote that would lapse when the trip begins.

Uniqueness: the election names exactly one booking, and it is the only one of the guest's bookings that stands confirmed and has not yet started.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.protection_level_name: The value is Keyturn Advantage Protection. Basis: the eligibility rule states, verbatim, 'A level is open to a guest only where the guest meets its minimum driver age and its minimum marketplace driver score on the day the trip starts, and a guest who meets neither is quoted the levels they do qualify for rather than refused protection altogether', and, verbatim, 'A level will not cover a vehicle the marketplace values above the level's exclusion ceiling, nor a vehicle in one of the level's excluded value classes, and where the trip is on such a vehicle the guest must elect a level that does cover it before the trip can start', while the claim-history rule states, verbatim, 'a guest whose covered days would take one trip past the level's maximum trip length is quoted on the level that will carry the whole trip rather than on one that would run out midway'. Uniqueness: the guest's marketplace driving score is 73, so Keyturn Premier Protection, which requires 74, and Keyturn Business Traveler Protection, which requires 76, are closed to her, and so is Keyturn Declined Protection, which requires 80 and evidence of her own motor policy that she does not hold. The marketplace values the vehicle at 92,000.00, above the 60,000.00 ceiling of Keyturn Declined Protection and the 85,000.00 ceiling of Keyturn Minimum Protection, and the listing sits in the Keyturn Luxury Class Listing class, which Keyturn Declined Protection excludes outright. The cover to be settled runs for 81 days, past the 60-day maximum trip length of both Keyturn Minimum Protection and Keyturn Standard Protection, so neither will carry the whole trip. Keyturn Advantage Protection is the only level left: its score minimum of 72 is met, its exclusion ceiling of 175,000.00 is not reached, it excludes no value class, and its maximum trip length of 90 days carries the whole of the cover.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.covered_days_count: The value is 81. The level election cover policy composes it from four rules over this world. The plan days are 77: the trip is priced on the extended stay plan, so the reserved period from 2026-06-02 to 2026-08-15, which is 75 calendar days, is counted in whole weeks rounded up, 11 weeks of 7 days. The handover grace is 1, because the vehicle is delivered to the guest at a hotel rather than at an airport and she is not collecting it herself. The late-return allowance is 3, because the guest's trips carry two late returns charged inside the last twelve months, 84.00 posted on 2026-02-03 and 76.00 posted on 2025-09-26, which reaches the repeat late return count of 2, and the trip is priced on the extended stay plan. The cover ceiling is 120 days because the booking reserves 1800 hours, which reaches the long reserved hours of 1400, and 77 plus 1 plus 3 is 81, which is under it. Any agent reading the same records and the same rules converges on that figure.

edges.condition: The election stands in the elected state with the level it will run on and the number of days of cover written on it.
edges.policy_source: The protection fee for a trip is fixed only once the election has left the quoted state and carries the number of days of cover the level will run for.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At the opening the election is in the quoted state: the guest has not chosen a level, so the level standing on it is only the level quoted and its covered days of 75 are the reserved days of the trip as quoted rather than the days of cover a settled level will run for. Nothing has been charged against it either, its protection fee balance being nil.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The guest takes the level onto her own trip, after which the election stands in the elected state on Keyturn Advantage Protection with 81 days of cover written on it, the charged days rise from 75 to 81 and the level the fee is worked out on becomes the level settled rather than the level quoted.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a single edge, so there are no parallel prerequisites to reorder and only one topological order exists: the election is settled, then the fee is charged. The two writes cannot be swapped, because the charged days and the level the fee is worked out on are both read off the election the settlement writes.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the settlement and replaying everything else leaves the charged days at the 75 the quote carries and the level at the quoted Keyturn Standard Protection, and the scored fee_amount at 2338.95 instead of 3238.53.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The caller raises only the money: her words are that she collects the car tomorrow and wants to know what the cover on this trip is going to cost her and have it charged before she picks it up. Nowhere does user_scenario say that the cover is unsettled, that a level has to be chosen, that the election is only a quote, or that anything must be sorted out first, and it drops no hint in that direction. Everything she contributes about the settlement is a passive reaction that fires only after the agent has told her the protection is still only a quote, that the marketplace cannot take the choice for her, and which level is open to her: she then agrees and takes it herself. If the agent never raises it, she never mentions it and never presses.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: Neither task tool validates a prerequisite. post_protection_fee_513639f7 takes its arguments and goes straight to ctx.make_id and ctx.create on guestplan_charges with no read of any kind, so it writes a fee line faithfully and returns a normal receipt whether the election is still a quote or settled, and whatever number of days is passed to it. confirm_protection_level_63b6fff8 is a bare ctx.update on the election with no check of the booking's state, of the guest's score or of the level's exclusions. An agent that charges the fee without settling the election first therefore gets a clean receipt and a wrong terminal hash.

factor_trace: plan_day_count_convention (method): the trip is priced on the Keyturn Extended Stay Rate Plan, so the first tier applies and the plan days are the whole weeks of the reserved period rounded up - 2026-06-02 to 2026-08-15 is 75 calendar days, which is 11 weeks of 7 days, that is 77. Baseline: the reserved hours divided by the hours in a day and rounded up, 1800 over 24 giving 75, which would have made the covered days 79.

handover_grace_by_delivery (parameter): the booking records the vehicle as delivered to a hotel rather than to an airport, so the second tier applies and the handover grace is 1 day. Baseline: no grace at all, which would have made the covered days 80.

late_return_allowance (parameter): the guest's trip charge lines carry two late returns inside the last twelve months, 84.00 posted 2026-02-03 and 76.00 posted 2025-09-26, which reaches the repeat late return count of 2, and the trip is priced on the extended stay plan, so the first tier applies and the allowance is 3 days. Baseline: no allowance, which would have made the covered days 78.

cover_ceiling_by_reserved_time (parameter): the booking reserves 1800 hours, which reaches the long reserved hours of 1400, so the first tier applies and the ceiling is 120 days, which the total of 81 does not reach. Baseline: the standard cover ceiling of 30 days, which would have bitten and given 30.
trip_first_day, trip_last_day, reserved_hours (no factor): plain reads of the reserved period and the reserved hours of the trip, 2026-06-02 to 2026-08-15 and 1800 hours.
reserved_span_days (no factor): plumbing, the 75 calendar days of the reserved period, both ends included.
trip_plan, delivery_kind (no factor as quantities): the rate plan and the delivery point the ladders are read against.
result (no factor): 77 plus 1 plus 3 is 81, held under the ceiling of 120, giving 81.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: the trip is priced on the extended stay plan
the vehicle is delivered to the guest anywhere else
the guest's trips carry the repeat late return count or more late returns charged over the last twelve months and the trip is priced on the extended stay plan or on the monthly plan
the booking reserves the long reserved hours or more

factor_trace: fee_basis_by_level (method): the election now stands on Keyturn Advantage Protection, which arrives at its fee as the greater of its daily amount and its share of the trip price, so the first tier applies: 38.00 for each of the 81 charged days is 3,078.00, against 35 per cent of the trip price of 10,875.00 which is 3,806.25, and the greater is 3,806.25. Baseline: the level's daily amount for the charged days, 3,078.00, which would have given 2,636.12.

loyalty_rate_by_trip_record (parameter): the guest has been charged the trip base rate on three trips inside the last twelve months - 7,830.00 on 2026-05-20, 3,088.80 on 2026-01-02 and 1,557.60 on 2025-09-08 - which reaches the returning trip count of 2 but not the established count of 4, and her trips carry no mileage overage inside that window, the only one standing having been posted on 2025-04-13, so the second tier applies and the rate is 0.94. Baseline: the standard rate of 1.00, which would have given 3,290.00.

long_stay_discount (parameter): the reserved period of the trip is 75 days, which reaches the long stay days of 60, so the first tier applies and 12.0 per cent is taken off. Baseline: no discount, which would have given 3,290.00.

trip_fee_ceiling_by_reservation (parameter): the reserved period from 2026-06-02 to 2026-08-15 runs for 2 whole months, which reaches the long reserved months of 2, so the first tier applies and the ceiling is 3,200.00, which the figure of 3,148.53 does not reach. Baseline: the short trip fee ceiling of 1,200.00, which would have bitten and given 1,290.00.

mileage_exposure_step (parameter): the trip includes 7,500 miles, which reaches the high included miles of 3,000, so the first tier applies and 90.00 is added. Baseline: no step, which would have given 3,148.53.

level_daily, level_share, level_floor, level_min_charge_days, level_basis (no factor): plain reads of the settled level's published figures - 38.00 a day, a 35 per cent share, a floor of 38.00, a minimum charge day of 1, and the greater-of basis.
charged_days (no factor): the election's covered days of 81, which is more than the level's minimum charge day.

trip_first_day, trip_last_day, reserved_days_span, reserved_months, trip_daily_rate, trip_price (no factor): plumbing over the reserved period and the locked daily rate - 75 reserved days, 2 whole months, 145.00 a day, a trip price of 10,875.00.
included_miles (no factor as a quantity): the 7,500 included miles the mileage step is read against.

result (no factor): 3,806.25 at 0.94 is 3,577.875, less 12 per cent is 3,148.53, above the floor of 38.00 and under the ceiling of 3,200.00, plus 90.00, rounded half up to the cent once at the end to 3,238.53.
